# Variables Referencing No Yes Response Codelist C66742

The codelist **No Yes Response (C66742)** is **non-extensible** and contains four permitted values: `N`, `NA`, `U`, and `Y`.

[Source: terminology/core/general_part4.md]

It is referenced by **123 variables** across **53 domains**. Below is the exhaustive list, organized by domain:

---

## AE — Adverse Events (13 variables)
| Variable | Variable Name |
|----------|--------------|
| AE.AECONTRT | Concomitant or Additional Trtmnt Given |
| AE.AEPRESP | Pre-Specified Adverse Event |
| AE.AESCAN | Involves Cancer |
| AE.AESCONG | Congenital
